bag_policy.diverse_bag: anchor p0=(epoch+g)%n; slots=(p0+k)%n for k=0..3 (cycle when n<4)
bag_policy.inference: matched 4-slot policy, fixed epoch=0 rotation; descriptive all-promoter also reported
bag_policy.n_lt4_note: genes with n<4 promoters cycle so repeated promoters carry extra sampling weight in mean
bag_policy.repeat_bag: anchor p0=(epoch+g)%n repeated in all 4 slots
